hand.title: Daily Hand

events.text: Your cards — 3, J. Both players called a raise before the cards were dealt.
Turn — Jack. Your opponent led out with a bet. You called.
River — 3. Your opponent fired again — half the pot.

wrongReasons: K 9 has little reason to lead the river here — one pair can't comfortably go for value after calling two streets.
7 9 has little reason to lead the river here — high card can't comfortably go for value after calling two streets.
7 Q has little reason to lead the river here — high card can't comfortably go for value after calling two streets.
hand.explanation:
Answer: 4 A

Your opponent flopped a straight and immediately raised to build the pot. They led every remaining street — consistent value betting across all streets is a strong signal of a made hand.
